ns2:section.sectionText: ENGL 564: Cultures of Climate Change This course will consider the ways literary and cultural production can help us understand the emergence—and the emergency—of climate change. Through the study of fiction, nonfiction, poetry, and film, we will investigate the historical development, present crises, and possible futures of a warming world. Authors might include: Jesmyn Ward, Ben Lerner, Amitav Ghosh, and Anja Kampmann.
